description: This Java class demonstrates the usage of the Android Action Bar, including menu inflation, search functionality with SearchView, and handling menu item selections within an Activity.

classes.name: ActionBarUsage
classes.description: An Activity showcasing how to use the Action Bar with menu options and search functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creating a TextView for search feedback and setting the activity's content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu from XML, sets up SearchView, and assigns query text listener.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu icon based on the current sort mode.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, showing a toast message.

methods.name: onSort
methods.description: Handles the sort menu item click, updates sort mode, and refreshes menu.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Updates the display TextView with the current search query.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Shows a toast indicating a search submission.
